adjudication.rationale: The diff adds routed endpoints `get/put /admin/customize/embedding` (config/routes.rb) and an `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` that performs no persistence and simply `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)` (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb). On the client, `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` defines `saveChanges()` that calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but `admin/templates/embedding.hbs` contains no UI element/action wired to `saveChanges` (only per-host save/delete within the component and an `addHost` button). This makes the PUT endpoint effectively a no-op/dead surface (even if intended as a placeholder), but it doesn't break existing functionality, so it's an important review issue rather than a clear defect.
